note: Content-format templates distilled from the IG reference corpus (TASK-IG-VYR-09). Every template is constrained by the VYR-009 compliance gate: no third-party characters or IP, no gate-excluded categories, money stories never advice. Source strategies name only lawful sources (stocked catalogues, provenance intake, owner media).

hard_rules: original story and characters only
no third-party footage outside the licence gate
templates.name: Cinematic short film
templates.source_strategy: catalogue first; generated shots only via the provenance intake (TASK-IG-VYR-07)

structure.note: one striking visual, no narration
narrated setup
stakes rise, visuals tighten
the reveal or reversal
one memorable closing line

hard_rules: characters must be ORIGINAL creations owned by the channel
never depict game, anime, film or any third-party characters
no gameplay footage

templates.source_strategy: character art is owner-created or provenance-intake generated; backgrounds from the catalogues

structure.note: the recurring character states today's predicament
three escalating story beats
